item.title: Ukraine is littered with landmines on a scale last seen in Vietnam. How can they be removed?
item.description: Faced with deadlier threats, demining groups are coming up with new ways of working using drones and AI Crouched over on her hands and knees in a field of weeds, Olena Kabanova is digging into the ground. With a shovel and a steady hand, the 58-year-old digs out a neat square around the spot where a mine detector has sensed a suspicious object. Four years ago, this field in eastern Ukraine was occupied by Russian soldiers. Now back under Ukrainian control, it is littered with landmines. Civilians such as Kabanova are trying to make the land usable again. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: ¿Qué implica el diagnóstico de cáncer del papa León XIV y qué se puede esperar de su recuperación?
item.description: La salud del Papa León XIV ha generado preocupación después de que el Vaticano confirmara que padece un adenocarcinoma pulmonar, un tipo de cáncer de pulmón detectado tras una intervención quirúrgica. ¿Qué implica este diagnóstico y qué esperar de la recuperación del sumo pontífice? Rafael Beltrán, cirujano de tórax y exdirector de la Unidad Funcional de Cirugía de Tórax del Instituto Nacional de Cancerología, aborda el tema en France 24. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Papa León XIV fue diagnosticado con cáncer de pulmón tras ser operado con éxito
item.description: El Papa León XIV fue diagnosticado con un adenocarcinoma pulmonar, un tipo de cáncer de pulmón, tras someterse a una operación en el Hospital Gemelli de Roma. Durante la intervención, los médicos extirparon el lóbulo inferior de su pulmón derecho y el Vaticano informó que la cirugía se realizó con éxito y sin complicaciones. Aunque el pontífice se recupera favorablemente, hay preocupación por su salud y la gira que tenía planeada en Latinoamérica. Publicado también por: La Nación - El Mundo. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Ceuta an 'inalienable' part of Spain, king says on key visit
item.description: King Felipe VI on Tuesday said Ceuta and Melilla were "an inalienable part" of Spain as he made a landmark visit to the north African territories claimed by neighbouring Morocco. "Ceuta and Melilla are an inalienable part of the political and national reality that is Spain. The sovereignty and territorial integrity of our country are not negotiable," Felipe said. FRANCE 24's Sarah Morris reports from Madrid. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: The Chicks review – exquisite harmonies and hard-won vindication in anniversary show
item.description: Beacon Theatre, New York Two decades after country music blacklisted the band for their Iraq war protest, the trio celebrate their unapologetic album Taking the Long Way Last month, with almost no fanfare, the US formally completed its withdrawal of troops from Iraq, after 23 years of violent quagmire. But it was the beginning of that conflict that loomed over New York’s Beacon Theatre on Monday night, where the Chicks played the second of three sold-out shows. In March 2003, eight days before the US invaded Iraq, the country supergroup’s lead singer, Natalie Maines, said on stage in London… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.
